description: Export a Canva design and add it to the media library: a PNG (as picture; all_pages brings every page up to 10, in order, for a carousel) or an MP4 (as video). Usually answers ready; otherwise check media_get until ready or failed. Use the media ids on post_create like any upload.

as.description: picture: PNG; video: MP4 shaped like the design (1080p)

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: canva_design_import
title: Add a Canva design
